text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training is over.
As I take out my notebook to check upcoming plans—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My hand slipped, and I dropped it!
Unfortunately, right into a puddle...
choice_data_list: *sigh* I need to buy a new one...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you'd like,
shall I make a cover for your planner?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It might just be small comfort,
but I think it should protect your notebook a bit from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate it, but
won't it be too much trouble for Nishino Flower?
If so—
choice_data_list: I'd feel bad having you do that much for me.

text_block_list.text: Oh dear, what a waste!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What a waste, Trainer!
The covers Flower makes are
absolute masterpieces, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That fishing gear cover they made for me the other day is so sturdy, it laughs in the face of sea winds and mountain breezes~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! It feels amazing to use!
I almost want to ask you to make another one~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I made it from scratch using a pattern, so I was worried,
but I'm so happy you like it...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll make another fishing gear cover for you!
I still have plenty of cloth left over—

Hmm?
Well then, I shall take some for research purposes as well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Flower-kun's arm covers
are truly magnificent, you see!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Scientific, physical, it doesn't matter!
Time and time again, it has protected my upper arm
from every conceivable kind of explosion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!!
Furthermore, it feels delightful against the skin—truly comfortable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Its strength and structure are fascinating...
I believe this could be applied to my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my analytical work, by all means!
I would love to have one more arm cover!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No... Let's make this a joint research project!
You're free to use the lab however you like. Well? How does that sound?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much.
Knowing you thought so passionately about it... makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm really just cooking like I always do, so calling it 'research' is far too grand...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non!
Flower's cover was simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Taiki-senpai!
I-Is it... amazing?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The grip cover made for me
to practice gun-spinning is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times you drop it! No matter how much you rub it! It won't tear at all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "I've never seen that kind of cover, even in America, the birthplace of it all!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In other words—No. 1!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, fans of Nishino Flower's cover
had gathered around, each expressing their heartfelt praise.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To see you so pleased with it...
I only made it for fun, so I was worried I might be overstepping—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Meddlesome? No way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh... Thank you so much!
I'm so happy! I'm so happy that, well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh... my cheeks feel so hot!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the planner cover too.
I'm looking forward to the planner cover too!
I think it's okay to be even happier about it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh... my cheeks feel so hot!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the planner cover too.
I'm looking forward to the planner cover too!
I think it's okay to be even happier about it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! A planner cover, right?
Leave it to me, I'll make it in no time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To bring everyone joy...
I'll put all my heart into it! For every single one of you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I gained even more fans...
Well, I guess that's just bound to happen~."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Even more than this...?
Wh-What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Puff your chest out with pride!
Because Flower, you're everyone's No. 1!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood!
With all my gratitude to everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ei!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much...!
Just knowing how you feel makes me truly happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At those words, all the enthusiasts
nodded quietly in unison.
